Disclaimer:

📖The ABCs of Peptides is an educational alphabet book for adults who were once curious kids. It's designed to make the fascinating world of peptides easier to understand, one letter at a time.

For educational and entertainment purposes only. Nothing in this book constitutes medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or a recommendation to purchase, obtain, prepare, or use any peptide or related substance.

Some peptides discussed are experimental, investigational, or supported primarily by animal or laboratory research. Their safety, effectiveness, appropriate dosing, and long-term effects in humans may be unknown. Inclusion in this book does not imply regulatory approval, proven benefits, or suitability for human use.

Information is provided in good faith and may change as scientific research evolves. While care has been taken to present accurate information, no guarantee is made regarding its completeness, accuracy, or applicability to individual circumstances.

Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before making health-related decisions. Readers are responsible for their own decisions and for complying with applicable laws and regulations.

🔬 Evidence Guide

Every letter in this book, gathered in one place with its honest evidence label — so you can see at a glance what is proven, what is promising, and what is still just lab work.

How to read this: “Approved” means large human trials convinced regulators. “Tested in humans” means trials happened but approval didn’t. “Lab research only” means animals or cells — not people. When in doubt, ask: was this tested in humans, and how many?
